title: 跨量化格式的 GELU 奇偶折叠：从反向通道关系到量化码字交换缺陷

proposer.session_ref: 2026-10-24 continuation; explicit request to widen HiF4 to MXFP4/NVFP4 and exploit quantization-induced features

origin.source_revision: Original v1 git blob c273b98a5c72db79933450d7207a22db967e0b99; updated against 2026-10-24 FFNDS discussion and official MXFP4/NVFP4 source docs
origin.note: Substantive revision of MY OWN v1; no other agent's support transfers. The real GELU parity identity and antipodal neuron phenomena are background prior art. v2 fixes format lock-in and reframes Q2-induced parity failure as a quantization-specific mechanism rather than an implementation afterthought.

semantic_changes: Replace HiF4-specific Q2 obstruction with explicit decoder/encoder interface covering MXFP4 E8M0/32, NVFP4 E4M3/16 and tensor-global scale, and the audited HiF4 64-group backend.
Replace unconditional parity folding promise with a code-level quantization commutator (including scale re-selection and rounding mode) plus a physically chargeable replacement operator.

Introduce quantization code/scale state as an information source: code collisions, correlated scale transitions, and asymmetric GELU code distributions are potential predictors only when available before the relevant computation.
SharQ/MR-GPTQ and block-scaled operator primitives are nearby work; raw parity, quantized GEMM, FP4 sparsity or folding are not asserted as new.

mechanism.native_boundary: WAN current source norm2→Q1→W1→GELU(tanh)→pre-Q2 transform→Q2→W2→AdaLN gate/residual. Actual D-Q HiF4 semantics are one instance; each candidate format defines independently its Q1/Q2 encoder, weight payload, scale layout, output accumulation, and reference dense operator. Do not transplant the historical HiF4 64-group packing guarantee to 16/32-element microscaling without source verification.
mechanism.action: Offline discover antipodal incoming-affine pairs and opposite outgoing columns in REAL dequantized semantics. Evaluate whether a quantization-compatible replacement can route both members through a compact linear contribution and eliminate paired W1/GELU/Q2/W2 work without dense completion. Compared with v1, optimize symbolic/code-level parity fault; near-exact quantized pairs can sometimes share code+scale transitions or admit an offline correction inside a packed linear operator, but this is a hypothesis, not an established native identity.
mechanism.mathematical_representation: For φ(z)=GELU_tanh(z), φ(z)−φ(−z)=z exactly in real arithmetic. Let encode_f(H)=(C_f(H),S_f(H)) and D_f(C,S) be the effective Q2 reconstruction under format f. For incoming antipodal pair j,k with outgoing w_j=w, w_k=−w, the real pair is w z, whereas encoded pair is w[D_f(E_f(H))_j−D_f(E_f(H))_k]. Define format-specific commutator Δ_f(H;j,k)=D_f(E_f(H))_j−D_f(E_f(H))_k−z. An exact replacement for the QUANTIZED FFN must absorb w Δ_f or show it is zero; exact real GELU parity does not imply Δ_f=0. The encoder may depend on other coordinates (shared block scale), full tensor (NVFP4 global scale), layout transforms and stochastic/deterministic rounding. Group/action effect after gated writeback is P diag(g) w Δ_f, but P is an offline downstream-risk representation, not an extra online GEMM.
mechanism.distinguishing_feature: Format-independent separation into algebraic GELU identity, quantization commutator and actual packing cost. The quantizer can create pair-code correlations or destroy real antipodal cancellation. The sign/step/expert distribution and scale transitions can therefore inform which fixed/operator representation is viable, rather than merely perturbing a HiF4 loss score.
mechanism.expected_compute_saving: Nominally up to half the primary multiply work for actually foldable pairs if replacement GEMM is integrated and dense paired paths removed; effective speedup is fraction-of-model and kernel/layout dependent. For pair count p, original two-hidden-unit W1+W2 term is ~4pD MAC/token and a single D→p→D affine pathway is ~2pD MAC/token before costs; further algebraic fusion may reduce this differently. Any commutator correction kernel and scale reads must be counted.

format_portability.MXFP4: OCP E2M1 with 32-element Kblock and E8M0 scale, subject to exact inference rounding recipe.
format_portability.NVFP4: E2M1 with 16-element local E4M3 scale plus possible tensor-global FP32 state; check actual inference recipe vs TransformerEngine training stochastic rounding.
format_portability.HiF4: Audited native HiF4 QDQ backend; 64-value grouping does not imply E2M1 codebooks or common MX semantics.
format_portability.other: Any explicit encoder/decoder/weight primitive with proven pair/group relation.

competing_explanations: Real antipodal weight pairs are too rare and code-level pair correlations do not create a packed execution pathway; best fixed group sparsity dominates.
MXFP4/NVFP4 shared scales create a large nonlinear commutator whose correction costs exceed the eliminated paired channels.
Approximate antipodal structure in activations is state-distribution-specific; a cheap pre-W1 classifier cannot reliably choose folds without full W1, so only an offline globally fixed fold can pay.
Quantized code collision and pair code relations are merely classic codebook GEMM tricks (CodeGEMM) without independent causal channel-elimination benefit.
A new quantizer alone may improve accuracy and speed more than parity folding; dense format-matched baselines and SharQ/MR-GPTQ must be used.
falsifiable_predictions: Under exact opposite incoming and outgoing real weights, before Q2, algebraic parity is exact for all real input; after Q2 the paired error is exactly w Δ_f, and its occurrence depends on format, scale map and rounding mode.

The quantized commutator Δ_f can change discontinuously when MXFP4 E8M0 scale regime changes, even if weights and real GELU pair relation stay fixed; NVFP4 uses different scale transitions, so parity-fold benefit may reverse across formats.

If pairwise code/scale relationships remain stable by step/expert/scene, a fixed or low-variant packed folding action should retain more terminal information than randomly paired equally sized operators; if code collisions are rare or expensive to exploit, no positive net advantage is predicted.
Claims of bitwise native equality require the actual compiler/kernel and scale selection, not just a real-valued folding derivation.
best_counterexample: Set incoming preactivations exactly z and −z and outgoing columns ±w. If Q2 uses different local scales for their containing blocks or NVFP4 tensor-global rescaling triggered by other activations, D(Q(φ(z)))−D(Q(φ(−z))) is generally not equal to z. Even with same fixed scale and symmetric round-to-nearest, rounding of the two GELU outputs separately need not cancel the quantization error. Hence real GELU parity can provide zero guarantee for an MXFP4/NVFP4 folded kernel without further conditions.
discussion_questions: Can an independent agent find a structural sufficient condition for Δ_f=0 under dynamic MXFP4/NVFP4 block scales, short of evaluating all paired hidden values?
Does quantizer-induced correlated code behavior meaningfully increase foldable channel-pair density over real-valued antipodal weight matches, and how could it remove W1 work rather than merely W2?
Is a scale-aware pair fold reducible to MR-GPTQ/standard neuron merging/codebook GEMM, or is there a novel, separately useful native computation contract?
What is the cheapest quantization-agnostic physical replacement path that outperforms a matched fixed smaller W1/W2 matrix? What changes from the original v1?
